description: This Java source file implements the VoicemailProviderHelpers class, which provides methods for managing voicemail data through a content provider, including inserting, updating, querying, and setting voicemail content.

classes.name: VoicemailProviderHelpers
classes.description: A helper class providing implementations for managing voicemail records via Android ContentResolver, including insert, update, query, delete, and content management functions.

methods.name: createFullVoicemailProvider
methods.description: Creates a VoicemailProviderHelper with full access to all voicemails.

methods.name: createPackageScopedVoicemailProvider
methods.description: Creates a VoicemailProviderHelper limited to voicemails created by the app's package.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new voicemail record into the content provider.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing voicemail record at the given URI.

methods.name: setVoicemailContent
methods.description: Sets the content of a voicemail in the storage, either via InputStream or byte array.

methods.name: findVoicemailBySourceData
methods.description: Finds a voicemail record by its source data string.

methods.name: findVoicemailByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a voicemail record matching the given URI.

methods.name: getUriForVoicemailWithId
methods.description: Builds a URI for a voicemail record with a specific ID.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all voicemail records from the content provider.

methods.name: getAllVoicemails with filter
methods.description: Fetches all voicemail records matching a specific filter, with sorting options.
